statements.summary: Today and tonight. Flood Watch. Heavy rain overnight Sunday night through Monday morning on an already saturated ground could lead to flooding concerns with rises in area creeks and streams.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: Today and tonight. Please listen to NOAA Weather Radio or go to weather.gov on the Internet for more information about the following hazards. Flood Watch. Heavy rain overnight Sunday night through Monday morning on an already saturated ground could lead to flooding concerns with rises in area creeks and streams.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Tuesday through Sunday. Rounds of rain are expected to continue through mid-week. Longer duration higher amounts could lead to river rises and areal flooding.
